notes.title: CPRDM: Appendix ABC Digitalization Requirements
notes.body:
# CPRDM: Appendix ABC Digitalization Requirements

## Scope and Evidence Basis

This document consolidates explicit Appendix ABC needs, pain points, and stated preferences from processed interviews P01-P11. Requirements are limited to evidence about maintaining, reviewing, versioning, integrating, and governing Appendix ABC data. Similar findings have been combined where they describe the same underlying need.

## Requirements

### R-01: Maintain One Reusable Appendix Data Record

**Requirement**  
The solution shall maintain product, supplier, site, and certification data as reusable structured records so that a change is entered once and reflected in every relevant Appendix view, project, and certificate context. A record may be referenced by multiple projects while retaining each project's specific identifier and status, without copy-and-rename workflows.

**Description / Background**  
All eleven interviews describe high-effort Appendix maintenance caused by repeated entry across Excel files, versions, and projects. Participants maintain large and changing portfolios, often with the same data repeated across several Appendix variants and uploads. The requirement is for a reusable underlying record, not another independently maintained file.

**Supporting evidence**  
P06: "Wir haben halt auch immer so, sag ich mal, doppelt und dreifach Pflege, weil jemand muss es ja auch in die Health Canada Datenbank eintragen, dann müssen wir es noch mal in das Appendix A. B. C. eintragen und dann noch mal in unser System eintragen."  
Translation: "We also always have double and triple maintenance, because someone has to enter it in the Health Canada database, then we have to enter it again in Appendix ABC, and then again in our system."

P11: "Das bedeutet fur uns, wir mussen diese Excel-Tabelle von Version 21 5 mal in 5 Projekte reinkopieren, funfmal noch mal diese spezifische CN Nummer an die Datei reinschreiben und das dann sechsmal, weil im Generalprojekt ja auch in UCI hochladen."  
Translation: "This means we have to copy Excel version 21 into five projects, write the specific CN number into the file five times, and do it a sixth time because it must also be uploaded in UCI in the general project."

**Derived user story**  
As a Regulatory Affairs user, I want to update a shared product or supplier record once so that every relevant Appendix and project uses the same current data without duplicate entry.

### R-02: Support Portfolio-Scale Data Entry and Reuse

**Requirement**  
The solution shall support bulk creation, update, import, and reuse of Appendix data for large product portfolios while retaining relationships among products, suppliers, sites, and certification contexts. It shall identify the full scope related to an assessed exemplar and support a controlled bulk update of in-scope records after the relevant assessment outcome.

**Description / Background**  
Participants describe thousands of products or codes, high-volume supplier data, and repeated item-by-item work. They also describe submitting one exemplar while many related products require subsequent maintenance. A digital Appendix must scale beyond manual row-by-row editing, preserve the relationships that make a record usable in a certification context, and keep the assessed exemplar distinct from the broader change scope.

**Supporting evidence**  
P05: "So now we're having to go back through now and do a complete assessment of the 10,000 CFNs and ensure that you know everything is accurate."

P07: "Das ist natürlich eine total händische Arbeit, am Ende sicherzustellen, dass diese Verknüpfungen zwischen den A, B und C nach wie vor gültig sind."  
Translation: "It is completely manual work to ensure in the end that the links between A, B, and C are still valid."

**Derived user story**  
As a Regulatory Affairs user responsible for a large portfolio, I want to identify the products affected by an exemplar assessment and update the approved in-scope records in a controlled bulk action while preserving their product, supplier, site, and certificate relationships.

### R-03: Integrate and Import from Authoritative Data Sources

**Requirement**  
The solution shall provide documented standard interfaces and bulk-import options for relevant manufacturer systems and EUDAMED, with mapping to the Appendix data model. It shall support controlled prefill from supplier or site certificates already issued by TUV and a staged manual-entry path when required data exist only in unstructured technical documents.

**Description / Background**  
Customer data are distributed across ERP, technical documentation, and other manufacturer systems. Some participants prefer direct system-to-system exchange, while others regard Excel upload as an acceptable practical alternative. TUV may already hold authoritative supplier certificate records, while other Appendix values may initially be available only across several technical documents. The requirement therefore supports reuse of authoritative TUV-held data, integration and controlled import, and progressive structured capture rather than assuming that every customer can use an API or already has clean source data.

**Supporting evidence**  
P03: "The solution of machine system that speak together will be the best solution."

P06: "Wenn man so das Appendix ABC als Datenbanken machen könnte, dann können die sich erstmal aus der EuDamed bedienen, weil da sind ja die Daten vorhanden."  
Translation: "If Appendix ABC could be made into databases, they could first draw from EUDAMED because the data are available there."

P02: "Für mich reicht eigentlich, wenn es so ist, theoretisch bei Udemed. Und von dem her, es muss keine Machine to Machine sein. Ich denke, mit Excel hochladen ist für uns vollkommen in Ordnung."  
Translation: "For me, it is enough if it is theoretically like EUDAMED. It does not have to be machine-to-machine. I think uploading Excel is completely fine for us."

**Derived user story**  
As a data owner, I want to import or transfer approved Appendix data from my existing systems so that I do not have to manually recreate information already maintained elsewhere.

### R-04: Map Common Data Across Certification Schemes

**Requirement**  
The solution shall maintain a common data model for shared Appendix information and map it to scheme-specific views, fields, nomenclature, and attributes for MDR, MDD, MDSAP, and other applicable schemes.

**Description / Background**  
Participants maintain parallel Appendix variants because their structures, terminology, and required information differ. A common record must not erase legitimate scheme differences, such as certificate-expiry data, but should eliminate duplicate maintenance of shared fields.

**Supporting evidence**  
P02: "Nicht mal Appendix ABC von MDSAP und MDAR sind angeglichen."  
Translation: "Not even Appendix ABC for MDSAP and MDR are aligned."

P10: "Was auch schwierig war, dass die unterschiedlich aufgebaut sind, gerade MDR, MDD, unterschiedliche auch Nomenklaturen teilweise verwendet wurden."  
Translation: "It was also difficult that they are structured differently, especially MDR and MDD, and sometimes use different nomenclatures."

**Derived user story**  
As a Regulatory Affairs user working across certification schemes, I want common data to be reused in the relevant scheme-specific Appendix views so that I only maintain scheme-specific differences separately.

### R-05: Enable Controlled Record-Level Editing

**Requirement**  
The solution shall allow authorized users to add, remove, and update product, supplier, site, and relationship records at item and field level instead of forcing whole-file replacement or parallel reference lists.

**Description / Background**  
Participants cannot always insert or remove rows in the current spreadsheet and must use separate synchronized attachments. They explicitly describe item- or product-level updates and database-style entry as preferable to a locked document workflow.

**Supporting evidence**  
P04: "Die eingeschränkten Rechte, also dass ich nicht Zeilen hinzufügen kann oder löschen kann."  
Translation: "The restricted permissions, meaning that I cannot add or delete rows."

P11: "Wenn wir das itembasiert oder produktbasiert updaten konnten, das ware, glaube ich, schon mal unheimlich hilfreich."  
Translation: "If we could update it by item or product, that would be extremely helpful."

**Derived user story**  
As an authorized Appendix maintainer, I want to edit the relevant record directly so that I do not need a separate reference list or a replacement spreadsheet for a small change.

### R-06: Enforce Role-Based Data Ownership and Approval

**Requirement**  
The solution shall enforce role-based access and approval rights for Appendix data, including manufacturer contributor and approver roles and notified-body reviewer roles. It shall prevent a party from setting certification-authority states or overwriting manufacturer-owned data without the required acknowledgement or approval.

**Description / Background**  
Customers describe the data as manufacturer-owned and need different permissions for contributors, approvers, and reviewers. This requirement preserves accountability while still allowing shared review.

**Supporting evidence**  
P07: "Je nachdem, was dann alles an Daten gepflegt wird und wie groß unsere Rechte sozusagen sind, da direkt was zu pflegen, möglicherweise sollte es noch sowas wie 'ne Admin oder eine quasi eine höher gestellte Rolle geben, die die grundlegenderen Approvals macht."  
Translation: "Depending on what data are maintained and how extensive our direct editing rights are, there may need to be an admin or higher-level role that makes more fundamental approvals."

P10: "Meiner Meinung nach hat der Hersteller die Datenhoheit, weil es unsere Daten sind."  
Translation: "In my opinion, the manufacturer has data sovereignty because they are our data."

**Derived user story**  
As a manufacturer approver, I want permissions and approval states to protect our Appendix data so that reviewers can provide feedback without silently changing our accountable record.

### R-07: Gate Data Synchronization and Automation by Approval

**Requirement**  
The solution shall synchronize source-data changes into Appendix records only when their regulatory approval state permits it. It may identify dependent updates and propose actions, but shall require an accountable user to explicitly approve or reject consequential changes before applying them.

**Description / Background**  
A source-system update is not automatically a valid certification-data update: it may need notification and approval first. Participants explicitly reject autonomous changes while accepting assistance that asks for confirmation.

**Supporting evidence**  
P11: "Wir mussen das ja erst mal bei euch anmelden und durfen ja auch nicht implementieren, bevor das approved ist."  
Translation: "We first have to notify you and are not allowed to implement it before it is approved."

P11: "Also automatisierte Anpassungen wurde ich gerne ausschliessen. Wenn dann mit Frage."  
Translation: "I would like to exclude automated changes. If anything, they should happen with a question."

**Derived user story**  
As an accountable Regulatory Affairs user, I want the system to propose dependent Appendix changes and wait for my decision so that automation does not bypass regulatory change control.

### R-08: Maintain a Single Controlled Version Lifecycle

**Requirement**  
The solution shall maintain a shared current Appendix state with explicit draft, submitted, review, feedback, reconciliation, and approved states. It shall prevent or clearly expose concurrent versions and preserve work completed while another party reviews the data.

**Description / Background**  
Customers and reviewers currently create separate versions while both continue working. Feedback then has to be manually re-entered into the active version, with a risk that updates are lost or overwritten.

**Supporting evidence**  
P01: "When we freeze the appendix ABC, we create a new version within revision. Afterwards, we receive in some weeks or a few days, it depends, a feedback of the file with the comments of TUV SUD, and we have to re-update our updating version."

P09: "Und da haben wir auch häufig den Fall, wir haben intern und Sie haben Änderungen gemacht und sich dann hinzusetzen und das wieder alles in eine Datei zu bringen, das ist wirklich viel Arbeit und auch fehleranfällig, dass der Kunde dann schreibt: 'O.K., meine Änderungen sind jetzt irgendwie nicht mehr in der Tabelle drinne.'"  
Translation: "We often have the case where we made changes internally and you also made changes, and sitting down to bring everything back into one file is a lot of work and error-prone, so a colleague then writes that their changes are somehow no longer in the table."

**Derived user story**  
As an Appendix maintainer, I want to see one controlled current state and the status of every change so that reviewer feedback and internal work can be reconciled without recreating data in another file.

### R-09: Provide Field-Level Audit History and Project Traceability

**Requirement**  
The solution shall record and display, for each Appendix field or record, who changed it, what changed, when it changed, why it changed, its review status, and the related project or change context.

**Description / Background**  
Manual version history and yellow highlighting are used as workarounds for a missing audit trail. Participants need to understand both the change itself and its link to the relevant certification project.

**Supporting evidence**  
P07: "Es gibt ja in dem Sinne keinen Audit Trail oder so, also wo man sieht, wer hat an 'nem Dokument was geändert, sondern es gibt ja nur diese manuell gepflegte Version History."  
Translation: "There is no audit trail showing who changed what in a document; there is only the manually maintained version history."

P09: "Also nachvollziehbar über 'ne Änderungshistorie wäre wichtig, dass man letzten Endes sieht, was ist an dem Datensatz aktuell geändert worden oder was ist in der Änderung und mit welchem Bezug zu einem zu welchem Projekt ist das gerade in der Änderung?"  
Translation: "A traceable change history would be important so that one can see what has been changed in the record, what is currently being changed, and which project the change relates to."

**Derived user story**  
As a reviewer or data owner, I want field-level change history linked to the certification context so that I can verify the current data and understand its provenance without comparing document versions.

### R-10: Support In-Context Review and Comment Resolution

**Requirement**  
The solution shall let manufacturers and notified-body reviewers view Appendix data in the project context, add comments directly beside the relevant record or field, assign or resolve feedback, and retain the discussion with the reviewed data.

**Description / Background**  
Downloading drafts, commenting elsewhere, and re-uploading creates an avoidable break between feedback and the data being reviewed. Participants explicitly request a view mode with adjacent comments.

**Supporting evidence**  
P11: "Wenn ich jetzt reingehen konnte in das Projekt und ich musste mir diesen Draft gar nicht herunterladen, sondern ich hatte eine View-Ansicht und konnte direkt daneben einen Kommentar reinschreiben."  
Translation: "If I could enter the project and did not have to download the draft, but instead had a viewing mode and could write a comment directly beside it."

P07: "Dann mussten wir aber wieder händisch rausfinden, welche Informationen hat der William eingetragen, damit wir dann unsere Arbeitsdateien übertragen können, damit wir beim nächsten Mal, wenn wir das schicken, seine Information nicht verloren ist."  
Translation: "We then had to manually find out what information William had entered so we could transfer it into our working files and not lose it the next time we submitted the file."

**Derived user story**  
As a manufacturer or notified-body reviewer, I want to discuss and resolve feedback beside the affected Appendix data so that comments are not lost between downloaded versions.

### R-11: Guide Data Entry with Contextual Rules and Validation

**Requirement**  
The solution shall guide users through Appendix data entry with scenario-relevant fields, contextual guidance, controlled value selection, formal completeness checks, and actionable validation feedback before submission. Validation feedback shall identify the failed rule, affected value or field, and corrective action rather than returning an unexplained error code.

**Description / Background**  
Users currently rely on lengthy training and wikis because cases vary and the spreadsheet does not explain requirements at the point of entry. They request contextual information, linked guidance, and automatic formal checks that identify missing or inconsistent data without replacing expert judgement.

**Supporting evidence**  
P06: "Ideal wäre es, wenn ich halt sage, ich möchte jetzt das tun, es gibt den Fall, den Fall, den Fall und dann werde ich durch diesen Prozess durchgeführt, welche Felder muss ich wie ausfüllen."  
Translation: "Ideally, I would say what I want to do, there are these cases, and then I am guided through the process: which fields do I need to fill in and how?"

P10: "Dass man da in gewisser Art und Weise und ich weiß, ihr habt dann betrifft darf ja dann auch nicht beraten, aber gibt es dann so eine Art Vorprüfung oder sonst irgendwas? Geht es in die Richtung, wo ich mir wünschen würde, als Kunde vielleicht dazu sagen, ich schicke das einfach mal zum Check ein und es läuft durch und gibt mir dann die formalen Punkte."  
Translation: "Could there be some kind of preliminary check? I would like to submit something for a check and have it identify the formal issues."

**Derived user story**  
As a less frequent Appendix user, I want the system to show the required fields, valid values, and formal issues for my scenario so that I can submit complete data without relying on a separate wiki or repeated clarification.

### R-12: Surface the Current Approved Appendix for Audit and Change Work

**Requirement**  
The solution shall clearly identify the current approved Appendix version and its applicability to audits, products, and changes. It shall support explicit guidance or tasks for when an updated Appendix is required before an audit or related certification activity.

**Description / Background**  
Participants report that auditors have reviewed outdated Appendix data and that manufacturers do not know whether to submit an update proactively or wait for a request. The solution must make the authoritative approved state visible and make update expectations actionable.

**Supporting evidence**  
P07: "Wir haben zum Beispiel dieses Jahr im Audit erlebt, dass die Auditoren in einer Version vom Appendix A. B. C. nachgeschaut haben, die total outdated war."  
Translation: "This year during the audit, the auditors reviewed a version of Appendix ABC that was completely outdated."

P07: "Das heißt, das wäre zum Beispiel so 'ne Sache: Sollen wir als Hersteller einfach proaktiv X Wochen vorm Audit 'ne neue Version einreichen, sollen wir warten, bis wir gefragt werden?"  
Translation: "That would be one issue: should we as a manufacturer proactively submit a new version X weeks before an audit, or should we wait until we are asked?"

**Derived user story**  
As an audit or Regulatory Affairs lead, I want to see the approved Appendix applicable to my audit or change and any required update action so that the notified body does not review outdated data.

## Evidence Constraints

- Automation must propose consequential Appendix changes for user confirmation; it must not silently update accountable certification records.
- Integration must respect regulatory approval gates. A change in a manufacturer source system must not automatically become an approved Appendix change.
- The solution must preserve manufacturer data ownership while allowing notified-body review and feedback.
- Direct system-to-system integration is valuable for mature data environments, but controlled bulk import is also explicitly acceptable for some customers.
- Notifications and reminders must be selective and task-relevant so that high-volume event alerts do not obscure critical Appendix actions.

sections.Scope and Evidence Basis: This document consolidates explicit Appendix ABC needs, pain points, and stated preferences from processed interviews P01-P11. Requirements are limited to evidence about maintaining, reviewing, versioning, integrating, and governing Appendix ABC data. Similar findings have been combined where they describe the same underlying need.
sections.Requirements:
### R-01: Maintain One Reusable Appendix Data Record

**Requirement**  
The solution shall maintain product, supplier, site, and certification data as reusable structured records so that a change is entered once and reflected in every relevant Appendix view, project, and certificate context. A record may be referenced by multiple projects while retaining each project's specific identifier and status, without copy-and-rename workflows.

**Description / Background**  
All eleven interviews describe high-effort Appendix maintenance caused by repeated entry across Excel files, versions, and projects. Participants maintain large and changing portfolios, often with the same data repeated across several Appendix variants and uploads. The requirement is for a reusable underlying record, not another independently maintained file.

**Supporting evidence**  
P06: "Wir haben halt auch immer so, sag ich mal, doppelt und dreifach Pflege, weil jemand muss es ja auch in die Health Canada Datenbank eintragen, dann müssen wir es noch mal in das Appendix A. B. C. eintragen und dann noch mal in unser System eintragen."  
Translation: "We also always have double and triple maintenance, because someone has to enter it in the Health Canada database, then we have to enter it again in Appendix ABC, and then again in our system."

P11: "Das bedeutet fur uns, wir mussen diese Excel-Tabelle von Version 21 5 mal in 5 Projekte reinkopieren, funfmal noch mal diese spezifische CN Nummer an die Datei reinschreiben und das dann sechsmal, weil im Generalprojekt ja auch in UCI hochladen."  
Translation: "This means we have to copy Excel version 21 into five projects, write the specific CN number into the file five times, and do it a sixth time because it must also be uploaded in UCI in the general project."

**Derived user story**  
As a Regulatory Affairs user, I want to update a shared product or supplier record once so that every relevant Appendix and project uses the same current data without duplicate entry.

### R-02: Support Portfolio-Scale Data Entry and Reuse

**Requirement**  
The solution shall support bulk creation, update, import, and reuse of Appendix data for large product portfolios while retaining relationships among products, suppliers, sites, and certification contexts. It shall identify the full scope related to an assessed exemplar and support a controlled bulk update of in-scope records after the relevant assessment outcome.

**Description / Background**  
Participants describe thousands of products or codes, high-volume supplier data, and repeated item-by-item work. They also describe submitting one exemplar while many related products require subsequent maintenance. A digital Appendix must scale beyond manual row-by-row editing, preserve the relationships that make a record usable in a certification context, and keep the assessed exemplar distinct from the broader change scope.

**Supporting evidence**  
P05: "So now we're having to go back through now and do a complete assessment of the 10,000 CFNs and ensure that you know everything is accurate."

P07: "Das ist natürlich eine total händische Arbeit, am Ende sicherzustellen, dass diese Verknüpfungen zwischen den A, B und C nach wie vor gültig sind."  
Translation: "It is completely manual work to ensure in the end that the links between A, B, and C are still valid."

**Derived user story**  
As a Regulatory Affairs user responsible for a large portfolio, I want to identify the products affected by an exemplar assessment and update the approved in-scope records in a controlled bulk action while preserving their product, supplier, site, and certificate relationships.

### R-03: Integrate and Import from Authoritative Data Sources

**Requirement**  
The solution shall provide documented standard interfaces and bulk-import options for relevant manufacturer systems and EUDAMED, with mapping to the Appendix data model. It shall support controlled prefill from supplier or site certificates already issued by TUV and a staged manual-entry path when required data exist only in unstructured technical documents.

**Description / Background**  
Customer data are distributed across ERP, technical documentation, and other manufacturer systems. Some participants prefer direct system-to-system exchange, while others regard Excel upload as an acceptable practical alternative. TUV may already hold authoritative supplier certificate records, while other Appendix values may initially be available only across several technical documents. The requirement therefore supports reuse of authoritative TUV-held data, integration and controlled import, and progressive structured capture rather than assuming that every customer can use an API or already has clean source data.

**Supporting evidence**  
P03: "The solution of machine system that speak together will be the best solution."

P06: "Wenn man so das Appendix ABC als Datenbanken machen könnte, dann können die sich erstmal aus der EuDamed bedienen, weil da sind ja die Daten vorhanden."  
Translation: "If Appendix ABC could be made into databases, they could first draw from EUDAMED because the data are available there."

P02: "Für mich reicht eigentlich, wenn es so ist, theoretisch bei Udemed. Und von dem her, es muss keine Machine to Machine sein. Ich denke, mit Excel hochladen ist für uns vollkommen in Ordnung."  
Translation: "For me, it is enough if it is theoretically like EUDAMED. It does not have to be machine-to-machine. I think uploading Excel is completely fine for us."

**Derived user story**  
As a data owner, I want to import or transfer approved Appendix data from my existing systems so that I do not have to manually recreate information already maintained elsewhere.

### R-04: Map Common Data Across Certification Schemes

**Requirement**  
The solution shall maintain a common data model for shared Appendix information and map it to scheme-specific views, fields, nomenclature, and attributes for MDR, MDD, MDSAP, and other applicable schemes.

**Description / Background**  
Participants maintain parallel Appendix variants because their structures, terminology, and required information differ. A common record must not erase legitimate scheme differences, such as certificate-expiry data, but should eliminate duplicate maintenance of shared fields.

**Supporting evidence**  
P02: "Nicht mal Appendix ABC von MDSAP und MDAR sind angeglichen."  
Translation: "Not even Appendix ABC for MDSAP and MDR are aligned."

P10: "Was auch schwierig war, dass die unterschiedlich aufgebaut sind, gerade MDR, MDD, unterschiedliche auch Nomenklaturen teilweise verwendet wurden."  
Translation: "It was also difficult that they are structured differently, especially MDR and MDD, and sometimes use different nomenclatures."

**Derived user story**  
As a Regulatory Affairs user working across certification schemes, I want common data to be reused in the relevant scheme-specific Appendix views so that I only maintain scheme-specific differences separately.

### R-05: Enable Controlled Record-Level Editing

**Requirement**  
The solution shall allow authorized users to add, remove, and update product, supplier, site, and relationship records at item and field level instead of forcing whole-file replacement or parallel reference lists.

**Description / Background**  
Participants cannot always insert or remove rows in the current spreadsheet and must use separate synchronized attachments. They explicitly describe item- or product-level updates and database-style entry as preferable to a locked document workflow.

**Supporting evidence**  
P04: "Die eingeschränkten Rechte, also dass ich nicht Zeilen hinzufügen kann oder löschen kann."  
Translation: "The restricted permissions, meaning that I cannot add or delete rows."

P11: "Wenn wir das itembasiert oder produktbasiert updaten konnten, das ware, glaube ich, schon mal unheimlich hilfreich."  
Translation: "If we could update it by item or product, that would be extremely helpful."

**Derived user story**  
As an authorized Appendix maintainer, I want to edit the relevant record directly so that I do not need a separate reference list or a replacement spreadsheet for a small change.

### R-06: Enforce Role-Based Data Ownership and Approval

**Requirement**  
The solution shall enforce role-based access and approval rights for Appendix data, including manufacturer contributor and approver roles and notified-body reviewer roles. It shall prevent a party from setting certification-authority states or overwriting manufacturer-owned data without the required acknowledgement or approval.

**Description / Background**  
Customers describe the data as manufacturer-owned and need different permissions for contributors, approvers, and reviewers. This requirement preserves accountability while still allowing shared review.

**Supporting evidence**  
P07: "Je nachdem, was dann alles an Daten gepflegt wird und wie groß unsere Rechte sozusagen sind, da direkt was zu pflegen, möglicherweise sollte es noch sowas wie 'ne Admin oder eine quasi eine höher gestellte Rolle geben, die die grundlegenderen Approvals macht."  
Translation: "Depending on what data are maintained and how extensive our direct editing rights are, there may need to be an admin or higher-level role that makes more fundamental approvals."

P10: "Meiner Meinung nach hat der Hersteller die Datenhoheit, weil es unsere Daten sind."  
Translation: "In my opinion, the manufacturer has data sovereignty because they are our data."

**Derived user story**  
As a manufacturer approver, I want permissions and approval states to protect our Appendix data so that reviewers can provide feedback without silently changing our accountable record.

### R-07: Gate Data Synchronization and Automation by Approval

**Requirement**  
The solution shall synchronize source-data changes into Appendix records only when their regulatory approval state permits it. It may identify dependent updates and propose actions, but shall require an accountable user to explicitly approve or reject consequential changes before applying them.

**Description / Background**  
A source-system update is not automatically a valid certification-data update: it may need notification and approval first. Participants explicitly reject autonomous changes while accepting assistance that asks for confirmation.

**Supporting evidence**  
P11: "Wir mussen das ja erst mal bei euch anmelden und durfen ja auch nicht implementieren, bevor das approved ist."  
Translation: "We first have to notify you and are not allowed to implement it before it is approved."

P11: "Also automatisierte Anpassungen wurde ich gerne ausschliessen. Wenn dann mit Frage."  
Translation: "I would like to exclude automated changes. If anything, they should happen with a question."

**Derived user story**  
As an accountable Regulatory Affairs user, I want the system to propose dependent Appendix changes and wait for my decision so that automation does not bypass regulatory change control.

### R-08: Maintain a Single Controlled Version Lifecycle

**Requirement**  
The solution shall maintain a shared current Appendix state with explicit draft, submitted, review, feedback, reconciliation, and approved states. It shall prevent or clearly expose concurrent versions and preserve work completed while another party reviews the data.

**Description / Background**  
Customers and reviewers currently create separate versions while both continue working. Feedback then has to be manually re-entered into the active version, with a risk that updates are lost or overwritten.

**Supporting evidence**  
P01: "When we freeze the appendix ABC, we create a new version within revision. Afterwards, we receive in some weeks or a few days, it depends, a feedback of the file with the comments of TUV SUD, and we have to re-update our updating version."

P09: "Und da haben wir auch häufig den Fall, wir haben intern und Sie haben Änderungen gemacht und sich dann hinzusetzen und das wieder alles in eine Datei zu bringen, das ist wirklich viel Arbeit und auch fehleranfällig, dass der Kunde dann schreibt: 'O.K., meine Änderungen sind jetzt irgendwie nicht mehr in der Tabelle drinne.'"  
Translation: "We often have the case where we made changes internally and you also made changes, and sitting down to bring everything back into one file is a lot of work and error-prone, so a colleague then writes that their changes are somehow no longer in the table."

**Derived user story**  
As an Appendix maintainer, I want to see one controlled current state and the status of every change so that reviewer feedback and internal work can be reconciled without recreating data in another file.

### R-09: Provide Field-Level Audit History and Project Traceability

**Requirement**  
The solution shall record and display, for each Appendix field or record, who changed it, what changed, when it changed, why it changed, its review status, and the related project or change context.

**Description / Background**  
Manual version history and yellow highlighting are used as workarounds for a missing audit trail. Participants need to understand both the change itself and its link to the relevant certification project.

**Supporting evidence**  
P07: "Es gibt ja in dem Sinne keinen Audit Trail oder so, also wo man sieht, wer hat an 'nem Dokument was geändert, sondern es gibt ja nur diese manuell gepflegte Version History."  
Translation: "There is no audit trail showing who changed what in a document; there is only the manually maintained version history."

P09: "Also nachvollziehbar über 'ne Änderungshistorie wäre wichtig, dass man letzten Endes sieht, was ist an dem Datensatz aktuell geändert worden oder was ist in der Änderung und mit welchem Bezug zu einem zu welchem Projekt ist das gerade in der Änderung?"  
Translation: "A traceable change history would be important so that one can see what has been changed in the record, what is currently being changed, and which project the change relates to."

**Derived user story**  
As a reviewer or data owner, I want field-level change history linked to the certification context so that I can verify the current data and understand its provenance without comparing document versions.

### R-10: Support In-Context Review and Comment Resolution

**Requirement**  
The solution shall let manufacturers and notified-body reviewers view Appendix data in the project context, add comments directly beside the relevant record or field, assign or resolve feedback, and retain the discussion with the reviewed data.

**Description / Background**  
Downloading drafts, commenting elsewhere, and re-uploading creates an avoidable break between feedback and the data being reviewed. Participants explicitly request a view mode with adjacent comments.

**Supporting evidence**  
P11: "Wenn ich jetzt reingehen konnte in das Projekt und ich musste mir diesen Draft gar nicht herunterladen, sondern ich hatte eine View-Ansicht und konnte direkt daneben einen Kommentar reinschreiben."  
Translation: "If I could enter the project and did not have to download the draft, but instead had a viewing mode and could write a comment directly beside it."

P07: "Dann mussten wir aber wieder händisch rausfinden, welche Informationen hat der William eingetragen, damit wir dann unsere Arbeitsdateien übertragen können, damit wir beim nächsten Mal, wenn wir das schicken, seine Information nicht verloren ist."  
Translation: "We then had to manually find out what information William had entered so we could transfer it into our working files and not lose it the next time we submitted the file."

**Derived user story**  
As a manufacturer or notified-body reviewer, I want to discuss and resolve feedback beside the affected Appendix data so that comments are not lost between downloaded versions.

### R-11: Guide Data Entry with Contextual Rules and Validation

**Requirement**  
The solution shall guide users through Appendix data entry with scenario-relevant fields, contextual guidance, controlled value selection, formal completeness checks, and actionable validation feedback before submission. Validation feedback shall identify the failed rule, affected value or field, and corrective action rather than returning an unexplained error code.

**Description / Background**  
Users currently rely on lengthy training and wikis because cases vary and the spreadsheet does not explain requirements at the point of entry. They request contextual information, linked guidance, and automatic formal checks that identify missing or inconsistent data without replacing expert judgement.

**Supporting evidence**  
P06: "Ideal wäre es, wenn ich halt sage, ich möchte jetzt das tun, es gibt den Fall, den Fall, den Fall und dann werde ich durch diesen Prozess durchgeführt, welche Felder muss ich wie ausfüllen."

**Derived user story**  
As a less frequent Appendix user, I want the system to show the required fields, valid values, and formal issues for my scenario so that I can submit complete data without relying on a separate wiki or repeated clarification.
